action: wakes, grips nightstand, plans escape

speech.text: Those words are a warning. We leave tonight.

action: dozes, ignores TV

action: stays asleep, dreams of food

action: sleeps, shivers from cold

action: lies awake, stares at ceiling

action: sleeps, keeps warm, fidgets

action: sleeps, watches TV

action: drinks water, eyes rimmed

action: sleeps, ears twitch

name: Dez Okonkwo
belief: I refuse to let anyone control my business, even if it costs me

name: Cass Deveaux
belief: Dez is undermining me; I must assert authority

name: Odette Ferreira
belief: This block feels like home; I deserve my own space

headline: Power outage sparks tension on block

event: Det. Yolanda Ruiz gets word that what they owe is wanted sooner than agreed.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: glares at the phone while rubbing her tired eyes
thought: The demand came down early, and Brennan thinks we can just absorb it.

speech.text: Shut that phone off, Kohl. We've got bigger problems than your calls.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: stares through the rain-streaked glass of the laundromat
thought: The messages won't stop, but the rain washes away everything else outside.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: pours hot water over the grounds without looking up
thought: Amara is out there in this rain, and I need her to just come back.

speech.text: Eat your toast before it gets cold, Malik. She'll be back soon enough.

name: Malik Reyes
action: stares into his mug, ignoring the rain outside
thought: Tee thinks she'll just walk back in, but I know how this goes.

speech.text: You're waiting on a ghost today, Tee. She ain't coming back easily.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: lowers the receiver slowly with shaking hands
thought: Ruiz is going to snap before this shift even hits noon.

speech.text: It was dispatch. They're asking about the file from downtown again.

name: Booker Lyle
action: counts the drawer twice, ignoring the rain outside
thought: The store is quiet, but Ivy still owes me what's mine.

speech.text: Check the back lock again. Water's seeping under the bottom frame.

name: Ms. Ivy Calloway
action: wipes the counter down with a dry grey rag
thought: Booker will be waiting, but he can wait another hour in this weather.

speech.text: Keep your voice down, Gil. The rain amplifies every little sound in here.

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: holds the receiver tight against her ear
thought: Prriya is watching again, pretending she doesn't care about what's coming.

speech.text: Hang up on them, Chidi. They aren't going to tell you anything useful.

name: Sgt. Hal Brennan
action: taps a heavy pen against the mahogany desk surface
thought: Ruiz is going to push until the whole floor caves in on us.

speech.text: Get some fresh coffee before Ruiz starts chewing through the drywall.

name: Ms. Priya Raman
action: stirs the burnt instant coffee with a wooden stick
thought: Nadia thinks she can outrun what's happening on Delmar Row.

speech.text: Put the phone down, Nadia. You've got an exam to prep for.

name: Elias Reyes
action: draws a small circle in the condensation on the sill
thought: Tee is worried about Amara, but nobody tells me anything.

speech.text: Is it still raining hard out by the corner store?

text: Tariq 'Tee' Bello corners Amara Bello at Tee's Barbershop about $600. They get another promise.
action: Tariq 'Tee' Bello corners Amara Bello at Tee's Barbershop about $600. They get another promise.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
text: Ofc. Brady Kohl tells the room something about Cass Deveaux that may not be true.
action: Ofc. Brady Kohl tells the room something about Cass Deveaux that may not be true.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: Stares blankly at the locked laundromat door.
thought: The mayor won't stop whispering in my head. I have to leave tonight.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: Tapping fingers against the counter while waiting.
thought: Kohl thinks he can stand there and look important. He knows nothing.

speech.text: You're blocking the register, officer. Move it along.

name: Ms. Ivy Calloway
action: Wiping down the front glass with a dry rag.
thought: These fools tracked mud all over my floor for nothing.

speech.text: Take your time, nobody's rushing you today.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: Adjusting the belt on his service weapon nervously.
thought: If Cass keeps pushing me, someone's going to get hurt today.

speech.text: I'm doing my job, Deveaux. Watch yourself.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: Wiping down the barber chair with a damp towel.
thought: Six hundred dollars isn't a joke, Amara. You have to pay up.

speech.text: Six hundred dollars, Amara. Don't look at me like that.

name: Malik Reyes
action: Kicking at the heel of his sneaker against the floor.
thought: Dez is losing his mind. I need to get out from under him.

speech.text: This rain isn't letting up. We're stuck here.

name: Booker Lyle
action: Signing the clipboard with a heavy fountain pen.
thought: Everything has a price, and Kohl is running out of currency.

speech.text: Sign for it and get it out of my sight.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: Staring blankly at the precinct bulletin board in silence.
thought: Lyle thinks he won. He hasn't seen the half of it yet.

speech.text: Tell captain I'm checking the Delmar files again.

name: Amara Bello
action: Folding a fresh stack of towels by the sink.
thought: He won't stop harping on the six hundred. I'll get it to him.

speech.text: You asked once already today, Tariq. Drop it.

name: Malik Reyes
text: Malik Reyes will not let go of something Amara Bello said weeks ago.
action: Malik Reyes will not let go of something Amara Bello said weeks ago.
